## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND plus SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND signal risk appetite, while HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) → flat | ABOVE TREND provides credit support.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit/flow neutral-to-supportive: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) → flat | ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) → flat | ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-accommodative: SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ABOVE TREND with TLT (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) ABOVE TREND and Yield Curve → flat | NEUTRAL; Dollar strength is NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech-led: XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND with semis SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND and momentum MTUM (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum showing leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US broad indices healthy: SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +5.57%) ABOVE TREND; EM strength notable: EEM (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rising: Speculation Index ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND with IWM (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND; crypto stress persists: IBIT (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed/weak commodities: CPER (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) CORRECTION and GLD (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) RECOVERY, while silver SLV (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) BELOW TREND shows metals under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak and a tail risk: XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND with oil ETFs USO (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY is the lone bright spot.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Core risk assets and tech (SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: XLY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: -0.71%) RECOVERY and several sector corrections (XLV, XLRE, CPER) are minor and worth monitoring.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure — tech and semis (XLK, SOXX) and EM (EEM) showing strength; reduce exposure to energy and commodity-exposed ETFs (XLE, USO, BNO) while bonds (TLT (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) ABOVE TREND) remain a neutral ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, Semiconductors SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND, Emerging Markets EEM (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND, Broad commodities USO (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) CORRECTION and natural gas UNG (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY for cyclical cues. BEARISH: Oil (USO (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) BELOW TREND) for downside risk to energy-linked balance sheets.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health gauge), XLK/XLF  (Tech vs Financials pivot) — watch cross at prior relative highs for leadership shifts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: energy/commodity weakness (XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND) and pockets of sector divergence (XLY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: -0.71%) RECOVERY) to monitor.
